description.blurb: The Pluto system has five moons, but Charon is so large that Pluto and Charon orbit each other around a common center of mass. The other four moons are much smaller. All of Pluto's moons are named for mythological figures associated with the underworld.
description.more: Pluto's entire moon system is believed to have formed by a collision between the dwarf planet and another Kuiper Belt Object early in the history of the solar system. The smashup flung material that coalesced into the family of satellites observed around Pluto. Charon was discovered in 1978, and is almost half the size of Pluto. The small moons of Nix and Hydra were found in 2005 by using the Hubble Space Telescope. Kerberos was discovered in 2011 and is located between the orbits of Nix and Hydra. Then in 2012, the little moon Styx was found by a team of scientists searching for potential hazards to the New Horizons spacecraft Pluto flyby in July 2015.
